changes.oldEnglish:
By default, your hotbar will automatically fill with items from your inventory and you can scroll through a category ([itemcycle]). If you would prefer to place items in the hotbar manually, you can change the hotbar behavior from the settings menu.

Hold the key for a populated slot to open its radial menu. With the default keyboard bindings, use the number of the slot. On a controller, use the Item Wheel control.

Automatic hotbar slots
1. Digging tools
2. Melee weapons
3. Ranged weapons
4. Gadgets
5. Blocks
6. Consumables
7. Food
8. Throwables
changes.newEnglish:
By default, your hotbar will automatically fill with items from your inventory and you can scroll through the item in a category's slot with ([itemcycle]).

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-automatic]

You can hold the hotbar slot number to open a radial menu, with all the items in the category.

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-radial]

If you'd prefer a simpler, more familiar hotbar, you can use the MANUAL mode:

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-mode-switch]

In manual mode, you can drag items directly to the hotbar.

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-manual]
